title: 第19章 吃过烤海带吗
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
妖风起得毫无征兆，地上的茶缸子和搪瓷盆瞬间被吹得东倒西歪。

    兄妹三人跑出来看。

    芽芽直接被风吹得一屁股坐地上，茫然地看着四周。

    苗苗想跑到蔡老太身边，愣是被风吹得往反方向踉跄，急得说：“不去那，不去那啊！”

    小破孩也聪明，还知道拐个弯找到避风的地方再拐回来。

    铁蛋倒是玩得很开心，张着嘴‘啊啊啊啊啊’的吃风。

    婆媳俩赶紧把孩子们搂进屋，再出来捡各种锅碗瓢盆，顺便瞭望魏建业什么时候回来。

    家属院暂时还没安排上院门，婆媳俩看到魏建业扛着两垒竹叶小跑朝家赶来。

    赵玉兰心疼还穿在丈夫脚上的新鞋子，情不自禁地迎出去。

    魏建业直摆手让人赶紧回屋。

    台风天最怕从天上掉下来啥玩意。

    不过他感动极了，要不咋说老婆孩子热炕头呢，这有人等确实就是不一样。

    蔡老太一直守着门，等魏建业一进屋立马把门关上。

    窗户也都关着呢，这屋里头瞬间就安静了。

    可外头好吓人啊，风呼呼的刮出鬼哭狼嚎的效果来。

    蔡老太喊：“玉兰，把灯点上。”

    赵玉兰立刻去拉抽屉，小心翼翼地捧出新买的煤油灯。

    按她的意思是买煤油就行了，回头叫丈夫拿个空墨水瓶当煤油灯也一样用。

    灯罩可贵啦，一盏得要两块五。

    婆婆真舍得！

    不过新灯罩就是亮堂哈，整屋子瞬间就敞亮了。

    地瓜味飘香满屋，赵玉兰想着该撤柴火了。

    她刚想开通往后院的门就被魏建业喊停，莫名其妙地看丈夫先去把连接里屋和客厅的那扇门给关上。

    魏建业给家里人解释着。

    撇去穿堂风的说法，海岛家属院的房子都是门对着门，夏天齐开时可凉快了。

    唯一要防的就是台风天。

    魏建业一脸后怕地回忆刚来海岛碰上的第一场台风，那时怕门被撞坏，又理所当然的想着空气对流保不齐更好，结果屋里的东西全给吹没啦。
content_en:
The demonic wind blew up without warning, and the teapot and enamel basin on the ground were instantly blown around.

The three siblings ran out to watch.

Ya Ya was directly blown by the wind and sat down on the ground, looking around blankly.

Miaomiao wanted to run to Mrs. Cai, but was stunned by the wind and staggered in the opposite direction. She said anxiously: "Don't go there, don't go there!"

The little boy is also smart and knows how to turn a corner to find a place sheltered from the wind and then turn back.

Tiedan actually had a lot of fun, eating the wind with his mouth open and saying, "Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh".

The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law quickly put the children into the house, then came out to pick up various pots and pans, and waited to see when Wei Jianye would come back.

There were no arrangements to go up to the gate of the family courtyard yet, so the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law saw Wei Jianye trotting towards home carrying two piles of bamboo leaves.

Zhao Yulan felt sorry for the new shoes that were still on her husband's feet and couldn't help but welcome them out.

Wei Jianye waved his hand and asked people to go back to the house quickly.

What I'm most afraid of during a typhoon is something falling from the sky.

But he was extremely moved. How about talking about his wife and children being on the hot bed? It was really different to have someone waiting for him.

Mrs. Cai kept guarding the door and immediately closed the door as soon as Wei Jianye entered the room.

The windows were all closed, and the room became quiet instantly.

But it's so scary outside, the wind is blowing loudly, creating the effect of howling ghosts and wolves.

Mrs. Cai shouted: "Magnolia, light the lamp."

Zhao Yulan immediately opened the drawer and carefully took out the newly purchased kerosene lamp.

According to her idea, just buy kerosene, or ask her husband to use an empty ink bottle as a kerosene lamp later.

Lampshades are expensive, costing two and a half yuan each.

My mother-in-law is so willing!

But the new lampshade is so bright, and the whole room becomes brighter instantly.

The smell of sweet potatoes filled the house, and Zhao Yulan thought it was time to remove the firewood.

Just as she was about to open the door to the backyard, Wei Jianye shouted to stop. She looked inexplicably as her husband went to close the door connecting the back room and the living room first.

Wei Jianye explained to his family.

Putting aside the idea of ​​drafts, the houses in the island's courtyard have doors facing each other, which makes it cooler in the summer when they are all open.

The only thing to be prepared for is a typhoon.

Wei Jianye recalled with fear the first typhoon he encountered when he first came to the island. At that time, he was afraid that the door would be broken, and he naturally thought that it would be better if the air convection was not ensured. As a result, everything in the house was blown away.
